sources.role: SBB station exterior plan, page 3: tracks 49/50 at western end of Bern. Station extent and platform identity evidence; not a surveyed track/switch alignment.

policy.method: Only exact reviewed route/operator identities with one terminal Bern call on original platforms 49/50 and the explicit adjacent operating point. Project platform onto the pinned SBB station curve and retain its station-centre side as an inferred terminal spur. Original Bern node stays in place; only Bern Wyler eastern approach remains connected at that node in the pattern-local graph. Full-context consensus and existing source validity, station/topology attachment, detour and stop-order guards remain. Preserve all previous successful paths. No running-track, switch or present-day itinerary certification.

Only these previously missing six route/operator-specific directed pairs can use the tighter-candidate service-road consensus. Every complete pattern on all eight reviewed routes is retained, including unsuccessful alternatives. Existing successful cantonal and supplementary paths take priority. No matcher fallback, missing call, failed consensus or detour override is admitted.

source.method: Input-dependent pfaedle extraction from the pinned Swiss PBF, adding service roads with original access/direction/turn rules. Routing profile tightens stop candidates to 20 m. No current operator itinerary or physical access certification.
source.description: Geofabrik Switzerland 2026-09-02; Solothurn eight-route service-road review with 20 m stop candidates

policy.method: Explicitly reviewed 2.236 mm LV95 gap between two non-tunnel Bus source-feature endpoints at Oberbuchsiten. Preserve original vertices and add one separately identified inferred connector, only in a supplementary graph for exact PostAuto 126 route and directed platform pair. No global near-endpoint stitching, coordinate replacement, road direction or present-day operator itinerary certification.

policy.method: For these two exact previously unresolved directed S29 platform pairs only, use the official operator/line-specific Bern 450_S_b geometry in every complete seasonal context before consensus. This rejects context-dependent 45 km FOT alternatives in favour of the 13.3 km S29 line. All other sources, successful published paths, original calls, attachment limits and whole-pattern admission rules remain unchanged.

Exact IC61/ICE route and original Interlaken Ost platform 5/7 crosswalk to the FOT node explicitly labelled tracks 5–8. Coordinates, platform labels and all original calls remain unchanged. Full-pattern standard-gauge routing and all-context consensus still apply. Only previously unmatched segments can use reviewed results; no attachment or detour limits are widened.

sources.geometryModel: Mode-filtered, bidirectional shortest-path inference on official network centrelines. No route/operator attributes, legal road direction, rail gauge/running-track or diversion certification.
sources.topologyRule: Exact LV95 source endpoints join within one mode, including an endpoint on another feature’s exact non-tunnel interior vertex. No interior-only crossing junctions, tunnel-interior joins, distance-based stitching or stop-to-stop straight-line fallback. Tunnel flags retained.
sources.coordinateModel: Original LV95 XY vertices; swisstopo approximate WGS84 conversion; seven-decimal output. Metre-level transformation, not survey precision.
sources.endpointConnectors: GTFS platforms connect to projected graph points within the mode snap limit; these short connectors are inferred.

metadata.scope: At least one original GTFS call coordinate in the unsimplified 2026 Solothurn canton polygon. Full journey retained, including every call outside Solothurn. No operator whitelist.
metadata.model: Scheduled interpolation on inferred official-network paths. Headway exactTimes=0 instances are representative, not exact departures. No observed vehicle positions.
metadata.admission: Complete original directed patterns only. Cantonal gaps may use separately attributed, compatible supplements with full-pattern consensus. Night services require supplementary geometry on every segment. Reservation/demand and unresolved patterns excluded.
